LanguageData.WFL_Hub_NoPages: The Community window has no pages to show.
LanguageData.WFL_Hub_PageFailed: This page could not be drawn and has been switched off for this session. The details are in the log.
LanguageData.WFL_Hub_ResidentsLine: {0} people live in the colony, in {1} families.
LanguageData.WFL_Quick_Intro: Suggests an entry-level profession for each adult from their skills and passions. Change any row, then apply. Nothing about posts, pay or the treasury is touched.
LanguageData.WFL_Quick_Offer: New to this colony? Quick setup suggests a profession for each colonist from what they are good at.
LanguageData.WFL_Quick_OpenTip: Suggest professions for everyone who has none, from their skills.
LanguageData.WFL_Quick_PresetTip_Light: Only clear fits, and few people in each profession.
LanguageData.WFL_Quick_PresetTip_Balanced: A fair share of the colony in each profession.
LanguageData.WFL_Quick_PresetTip_Broad: As many people as suit each profession.
LanguageData.WFL_Quick_Nobody: Everyone already has a profession, or no adult colonists were found.
LanguageData.WFL_Quick_ApplyTip: Assign every row shown. You can change assignments later on the Professions page.
LanguageData.WFL_Quick_UndoTip: Remove the assignments made by the last Apply.
LanguageData.WFL_Today_LevelTip_Normal: Routine work goes on in every module.
LanguageData.WFL_Today_LevelTip_Yellow: Raised by {0}. Modules stay ready; routine work continues.
LanguageData.WFL_Today_LevelTip_Red: Raised by {0}. Routine classes, rounds and check-ups wait; doctors stay free for the wounded and builders keep repairing.
LanguageData.WFL_Today_Counts: {0} with a role, {1} on a duty now, {2} free
LanguageData.WFL_Today_Help: The colony alert is published by the Military module and every other module adapts to it. A person on one module's duty is not sent to another's until it ends. People with roles in three or more modules are marked Busy.
LanguageData.WFL_Today_Overbooked: {0} people hold roles in {1} or more modules and may be stretched thin.
LanguageData.WFL_Today_BusyTip: Holds roles in {0} modules. Consider removing one on the Professions page.
LanguageData.WFL_Today_Nobody: Nobody has a profession yet. Use Quick setup on the Professions page.
LanguageData.WFL_Need_Posted: New need: {0}. See the Today page.
LanguageData.WFL_Need_Help: Things modules noticed the colony is missing. Each clears itself once it is met. Dismiss hides one you do not want to be reminded of until it has been met and comes back.
LanguageData.WFL_Need_DismissTip: Stop reminding me until this is met and comes back.
LanguageData.WFL_Prof_PeopleKey: Gold box: main profession. Bars show progress toward the next step of that career; a green arrow means experience came in recently. Click a profession to make it main or remove it.
LanguageData.WFL_Prof_RoleKey: Each role and who holds it. A star marks someone's main profession. Bars show progress; green arrows mean recent experience.
LanguageData.WFL_Prof_NoPeople: Nobody has a profession yet. Use Quick setup, or assign people on the Career paths view.
LanguageData.WFL_Prof_BarDone: Everything in this career is earned.
LanguageData.WFL_Health_Help: Green: working well. Amber: worth watching. Red: needs attention. Click a line to open that module's page.
LanguageData.WFL_Health_Unstaffed: {0}: nobody holds one of its professions
LanguageData.WFL_Health_UnstaffedHint: Assign people on the Professions page, or use Quick setup.
LanguageData.WFL_Health_Idle: {0}: {1} people hold roles but nobody has done any of its work lately
LanguageData.WFL_Health_IdleHint: They may have nothing to do, nowhere to do it (see Needs), or other work taking their time.
LanguageData.WFL_Health_NeedHint: See the Today page for what to build or fix.
LanguageData.WFL_Hub_NoProfessions: No professions are registered. Install a module that provides careers, such as Education or Community Care.
LanguageData.WFL_Hub_ProfessionsHelp: Anyone may be assigned to an entry-level profession. Higher levels need the qualification to be earned first; assigning is always your choice.
LanguageData.WFL_Hub_AssemblyHelp: The assembly meets to choose the people who hold the community's posts. Professions are assigned by you and never elected.
LanguageData.WFL_Hub_FamiliesHelp: Browse colony families here. Open a family to manage its people, relationships, home and affairs in the full Families window.
LanguageData.WFL_Hub_FamilyResidents: {0} family members living in the colony
